issues.message: CHK-001 userSees may be too abstract (does not contain specific output text in quotes). Should describe the exact text the user sees, not descriptions like "feature works correctly"

missing_red_evidence: Red evidence is triggered but no current red evidence record binds baseline head/material to the correct acceptance target and green relation. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.
express channel allows fast path, but recommend adding at least one verificationIntent.happy for CHK-001 to help REVIEW/test-coverage reviewer align.

missing_scope_check: scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence. Start a story-level PLAN scope reviewer with `proof-or-stop dispatch --storyId=B-0208 --agentType=proof-or-stop-review-scope-plan`; dispatch output is not gate evidence, and the proof-or-stop-review-scope-plan / scope-plan reviewer must finish by calling `proof-or-stop scope_check_save`. The implementation/main agent must not self-sign this evidence or manually edit story metadata. Local CLI guidance is not remote completion and must not be presented as receipt verification or production/full completion.
